content: Ɓakuli kùrcau nǝ Ibǝram
Anzǝm mǝnia ka, Mǝtalabangŋo nacau nǝ Ibǝram aɓa sǝna ama:
Sǝ Ibǝram na ama, <<Mǝtalabangŋo Ɓakuli, mana nda ɓoaro mala tangnakusǝu mò abanam, yì mǝnana ǝn panǝ muna raka, kǝ muna-ɓala mem Eliyeza, ɓwa Damaska na nǝ̀ liɓala mem ngga?>>
Ibǝram na ɗǝm ama, <<A pam amuna ɗang; acemani ka, mǝtúró-ɓala mǝnana à ɓǝli a ɓala mem ngga nda nǝ̀ liɓala mem ngga ra.>>
Pǝlǝa cau mala Ɓakuli yiu a baní ama, <<Mǝnia yì ɓwa ka pà nǝ̀ liɓala mò ɗàng. Muna-ɓwabura mô mǝnana awu nǝ bǝl ka nda nǝ̀ liɓala mò ka.>>
Mǝtalabangŋo pǝlǝa pusǝì a nza, sǝ ne wi ama, <<Loasǝ mǝsǝo a kùli pé, sǝ ɓal anlero ɓǝ̀ a nǝ gandǝì ka.>> Sǝ ne wi ama, <<Mǝno ka nda làkkì mala amunio andǝ amǝ'keò.>>
Ibǝram earnǝ Mǝtalabangŋo, sǝ Mǝtalabangŋo twali yì ka mǝɓealɓoarna na.
Nyar ɗǝm Mǝtalabangŋo ne wi ama, <<Mǝ nda Yahweh, mana pusǝo a purì ɓá nggea-là Ur a nzali mala amǝ'Chaldi ace po mǝnia yì nzali ɓǝ̀ duk girkuma mò ka.>>
Sǝ Ibǝram ɗì ama, <<Mǝtalabangŋo, Ɓakuli, lang sǝ mǝ nǝ sǝlǝ ama mǝnia yì nzali ka nǝ̀ duk girkuma mem?>>
Mǝtalabangŋo nyesǝi wi ama, <<Yinǝàm nǝ muna-ndá, andǝ muna-mbul, andǝ muna-gam, komǝye ka mbule tàrú, atārǝia andǝ kutugangyi andǝ muna-kutumurǝm.>>
Ibǝram yinǝ agir mǝnia kat a baní, pǝlǝa komǝye ateà ka zanzǝi aɓalǝu ɓari, sǝ nongsǝ abare man a nkanggari arǝia. Sǝ mala anyal ka zanzǝia ɗàng.
Adǝkǝlaki yiu à yi sulǝo amur alúgir mǝnia à nǝ̀ lia sǝ Ibǝram pǝria.
Lang pwari na rǝ kpa ka, Ibǝram ko a nggea ntulo mǝlime, pǝlǝa ɓe pǝndǝa cikcik mǝpà ɓangciunì yi gir múrí.

Pǝlǝa Mǝtalabangŋo ne Ibǝram ama, <<Sǝlǝ fa ama amǝ'keò nǝ̀ nggá duk abǝri a ɓè nzali mǝnana malea na raka. Amǝ nzali mǝno nǝ̀ tsǝia à nǝ̀ duk aguro, à nǝ̀ paria aɓata tanni arǝ pǝlǝa gbǝman-ine (400).
Sǝama mǝ nǝ lǝmdǝ ɓashi mem amur mǝno yì nzali nǝ̀ nggá dumsǝ aɓwana mô a guro ka. Nǝnzǝ́mò ka aɓwana mô nǝ̀ purî ɓá nzali mǝno, à nǝ̀ pur nǝ agirkuma mǝ'làkke a buia.
Sǝ we ka, ɓǝ̀ a ena ě mǝɓoarne mala akapana ka, sǝ a wúnǝ́ wu aɓa rǝpwala. À nǝ̀ tsǝkbaniò atà akeô.
A inea nza mala do ɓanza mala amunio andǝ amǝ'keò ka, à nǝ̀ nyare à nǝ̀ yiu a nzali mǝnia ɗǝm. Mǝno ka pà nǝ̀ pa adyan ɗang acemǝnana cauɓikea mala amǝ'Amor
malaká bik ban mǝnana nǝ̀ tsǝa mǝ nǝ tasǝ ɓashi mem amúrià ado ka ɗàng.>>
Lang pwari kpana sǝ ban bwalna ka, muna nkenye mana nǝ nkalang-bǝsa aɓalǝi kǝ loasǝ yele, andǝ ɓukan mana kǝ earki bǝsa ka, à yi puro sǝ à kùtí a nre ka anyama mǝnia à sangia ka.
A pwari mǝno ka Mǝtalabangŋo kùrcau nǝ Ibǝram ama, <<Mǝ nǝ pè amunio andǝ amǝ'keò nzali mǝnia, twal a kún myalmúr mala amǝ Masar aban ká kún nggeasala mǝgule, yi Yiufǝretis;
kat andǝ nzali mala amǝ'Ken, andǝ amǝ'Keniz, andǝ amǝ'Kadǝmon,
andǝ amǝ'Hitti, andǝ amǝ'Periz, andǝ amǝ'Refa,
andǝ amǝ'Amor, andǝ amǝ'Kan'ana, andǝ amǝ'Girgash, sǝ amǝ'Jebus.>>

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Tite 22:17; 26:4; Pur 32:13; Nggur 1:10; 10:22; 1Kpa 27:23; Rom 4:18; Ib 11:12.
Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Tite 12:1; Nehe 9:7-8; Atúró 7:2-4.
cauɓikea mala amǝ'Amor Ɓalli aɓa: 1Amur 21:26; Amo 2:9.

Mǝnia ka nda lǝmdǝ ama Ɓakuli pana eare male arǝ kùrcau male mana pè nǝ Ibǝrayim ngga. A nza mǝno ka ɓǝ̀ ɓwa kùrcau ka, nǝ̀ lǝmdǝ ama mǝsǝcau na nakiyi ka nǝ pak gìr ani: nǝ̀ pwan-myal girkusǝu, nǝ̀ ɓwe sǝ nǝ̀ nongsǝ abare ɗàngɗáng. Nǝ̀ gya nǝ̀ kùtí a nre ka bare man sǝ nǝ̀ nggǝ bangcau ama, <<Mǝnia yì gìr ɓǝ̀ kumam ɓǝ̀n bwal kùrcau mǝnia raka.>>
